sourceConclusions: 成功 bootstrap 完整 body 解码与原 generation/owner 校验后，在 setBootstrap 前 prepare；没有将 response status 当可用 bootstrap，未新增 await、UI 等待、业务 action、SQL 或 poll。
只为当前真实 InstalledWorkspace URL 准备；当前 URL 与响应 request scope/selector 一致，路由白名单同 rendering predicate。401、公有配置、失效 query、expiry、update-required 均不能带入有效 preparation。
selected 来自既有 cacheWorkspace；optional home 仅用后端唯一 owned personal 同次投影路由 hint。它不代替 fresh ticket/member/Org/principal 校验，也不把 selected 猜成 home。
预热与真实消费者交接同一 LiveChannels/LiveChannel 实例，保留 ready、coverageAfter、各 kind incoming invalidation 历史；没有另开 raw socket、假实体订阅或绕过 main 的连接上限。
render 只创建 inert owner；cache identity 在 committed subscribe/mount 首次绑定。不同 cache 对象不可借用历史；parent authority/route 退休影响所有已提交 owner，包括 StrictMode 普通 fallback；旧 cleanup/release 不影响新 lifetime/entry。
同 selected hint 仅在当前有效真实消费者已存在后释放预留；fresh selected mismatch 立即退旧 hint，home 只由实际合法 owner-wide subscription 确认；实际数据订阅 scope 没有被 hint 改写。
zero-key preparation 只具有首次可见连接尝试；原 visibility/disconnected real-subscription gates 保留，不生成空订阅 retry/poll 循环；最后真实订阅退出清除已有 retry/fallback。
read-observer、readFresh 谓词/次数、readBoundary、原五项 snapshot whitelist、Native batching、原 data read 参数与原 ticket 授权路径均未改变。旧 read 开始早于 live ready 时仍必须 catch up，即使其完成晚于 ready。
Routes 退休后的合法 reentry 使用普通新 registry；同文档 update-required 按原 transport-state 是 terminal，最终 App 测试已改为拒绝 stale ready，未通过改产品状态机制造恢复。

draftFindings.likelihoodBasis: 真实 provider 可以先确认 selected scope，再由稍晚挂载的组件注册该 scope；不依赖非法输入。
draftFindings.failurePath: prepare(S) → socket ready → mount → confirmWorkspace(S) → later subscribe(S)。初稿 confirm 提前释放最后 reservation，销毁 ready 历史并另开连接。
draftFindings.fix: 737767 用当前有效 subscriber 判断是否可交接；同 hint 未有消费者时保留，实际首次消费者到达后再释放。
cases: confirming the selected hint before its first real subscriber preserves ready coverage
draftFindings.riskScale: Occurrence and impact are ordinal reviewer estimates on 1–10 scales, not measured frequencies.

draftFindings.likelihoodBasis: 需要连接失败、重试已排队且最后真实消费者在重试前退出；断线和组件卸载均为正常可达事件。
draftFindings.failurePath: retain → real subscribe → disconnect schedules retry → last real unsubscribe while retain remains → old retry would request an empty-scope ticket。
draftFindings.fix: 61cdf 最后真实订阅退出时清除 retry 与 fallback；活 socket 的原续期规则保留。
cases: the last real subscriber cancels its scheduled retry while a preparation remains
draftFindings.riskScale: Occurrence and impact are ordinal reviewer estimates on 1–10 scales, not measured frequencies.

draftFindings.likelihoodBasis: 异步组件提交或 StrictMode 的 effect 清理/重建可与父 route/authority 退休交错；无需服务端授权失效才能到达。
draftFindings.failurePath: render creates inert owner → parent retires before first committed claim → failed claim previously fell back to a fresh ordinary registry; a later parent retirement also failed to reach a StrictMode fallback registry。
draftFindings.fix: 737767 将 provider cleanup 与 authority retirement 分离；每个 committed owner（包括普通 fallback）注册 authority disposer，已退休对象不能首次 claim/subscribe，旧 lifetime cleanup 不能关闭后继 lifetime。
cases: retirement before the first effect blocks old owners but not a new ordinary owner
StrictMode cleanup and setup use a new lifetime and old cleanup cannot close it
an authority retirement aborts an unfinished ticket and its result cannot revive a socket
draftFindings.impactLimit: 这是废弃 scope/连接生命周期漏洞；仍执行 fresh ticket，未发现或声称服务端权限绕过。
draftFindings.riskScale: Occurrence and impact are ordinal reviewer estimates on 1–10 scales, not measured frequencies.

draftFindings.likelihoodBasis: 同 scope 消费者可以在 current-workspace 确认之前挂载又卸载；需要特定时序但 API 合同允许。
draftFindings.failurePath: subscribe(S) → unsubscribe(S) → confirmWorkspace(S)。历史 Set 被误当成当前消费者，使尚无人接管的 reservation 被释放。
draftFindings.fix: c408/737767 读取当前 registry entry 的 hasSubscribers，而非曾订阅历史。
cases: a stopped historical subscription cannot consume the selected reservation
draftFindings.riskScale: Occurrence and impact are ordinal reviewer estimates on 1–10 scales, not measured frequencies.

draftFindings.likelihoodBasis: subscribe 的实体参数是 string，原 channel 明确允许非法 ID 为 no-op；registry 新增计数必须与这一既有拒绝分支一致。
draftFindings.failurePath: invalid entity subscribe counted at outer registry → inner channel returns no-op → confirm consumes selected reservation although no real subscriber exists。
draftFindings.fix: c408 在 registry 计数之前复用既有 LIVE_ID 条件；内层原校验仍保留，因此合法输入会经过两处同条件检查。没有扩大接受范围，也不会记录无效消费者。
cases: an invalid entity does not count as a consumer or consume preparation
draftFindings.impactLimit: 影响连接交接和 ready 历史，不构成非法实体数据访问。
draftFindings.riskScale: Occurrence and impact are ordinal reviewer estimates on 1–10 scales, not measured frequencies.

draftFindings.likelihoodBasis: 已登录用户从 workspace 进入 device 页面再返回是普通导航；Native bootstrapScope/selector 可完全不变，因此不会依靠新 bootstrap 自动恢复。
draftFindings.failurePath: workspace → /device retires preparation → workspace with same selector retains old bootstrap object → a new provider receives authority-retired preparation and silently cannot subscribe。
draftFindings.fix: cfe14be 保留 35aec 的 Routes handoff：新合法 workspace 只接收未 authority-retired preparation；退休时传 undefined 使用原普通新 registry。旧 pending owner 仍被旧 preparation 阻断。
cases: leaving and returning to a workspace starts an ordinary live lifetime without a new bootstrap
draftFindings.riskScale: Occurrence and impact are ordinal reviewer estimates on 1–10 scales, not measured frequencies.

draftFindings.likelihoodBasis: 真实 location.ts 先同步 history write 再 queueMicrotask LOCATION_EVENT；bootstrap body 的 Promise continuation 可位于两者之间。
draftFindings.failurePath: bootstrap continuation resumes after actual URL changed but before queued location notification updates requested.current; stale route ref previously prepared on an excluded route。
draftFindings.fix: cfe14be 在成功 continuation 同步读取 new URL(window.location.href)，核对同一 InstalledWorkspace 路由白名单、bootstrapScope 和 query selector 后才 prepare。
cases: a history write before its queued route notification blocks the old bootstrap preparation
draftFindings.riskScale: Occurrence and impact are ordinal reviewer estimates on 1–10 scales, not measured frequencies.
